row.scim_price_text: Usage-priced: logs $0.42/GB, traces $0.16/GB, metrics $0.06/GB; all features included
row.evidence: Coralogix's pricing page says "Pay for your data and nothing more. All features & support included." with no tiers, and its docs say Coralogix supports SCIM to automate user and group provisioning.
row.notes: No plan tiers: pricing is usage-based (units; logs $0.42/GB, traces $0.16/GB, metrics $0.06/GB, AI $1.50 per 1M tokens) with unlimited users, and every account gets all features including RBAC and SAML SSO, so SCIM carries no upcharge; per-user fields stay null. SCIM uses a Team API key (team-members and team-groups permissions) as bearer token against the region-specific https://api.{domain}/scim endpoint. Okta OIN app provisions (Create/Update/Deactivate); Entra gallery app is SSO-only and Coralogix documents Entra SCIM through a non-gallery app; OneLogin uses the generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)' app; JumpCloud has a catalogue SCIM app. Existing non-SCIM users should be deleted before enabling SCIM. Org-level SAML also does JIT provisioning.

plans.name: Usage-based (units)
plans.price_text: Logs $0.42 per GB, Traces $0.16 per GB, Metrics $0.06 per GB, AI $1.50 per 1M tokens; 1 unit = $1.50
plans.notes: Single usage-based plan with no tiers; unlimited users and hosts; all features included. 14-day free trial with 8 units.

auth.token_source: Settings > Keys > Team Keys: Team API key with team-members:ReadConfig, team-members:Manage, team-groups:ReadConfig, team-groups:Manage

operations.notes: Okta and OneLogin: create, update, deactivate. Entra: create users and groups, update groups, delete users and groups. Okta group push syncs group members.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users cannot log in to the team; on reactivation they regain access and keep all previously specified access controls.
deprovision.notes: Users are unlimited on every account, so seat release does not apply to pricing. The Entra integration documents deleting users and groups.

attributes.notes: Okta/OneLogin update firstname, lastname and username; Entra creates users with userPrincipalName, givenName and surname. No full SCIM schema reference is published.

roles.how: Roles and scopes are set per group in Coralogix; with Entra a system role (Platform Admin, Data Admin, Observability Lead, Standard User, Read-Only User, Security User) and an 'Exact' scope can be assigned to a group through the integration. Okta cannot sync roles.

limitations.text: Users already added to the account should be deleted before starting the SCIM integration (one admin may remain) and recreated through SCIM.
Okta cannot sync roles or scopes; they are edited in Coralogix per group.
Group names may only contain letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens (no periods).
Entra pushes users and groups every 40 minutes, through a non-gallery Enterprise Application.

endpoints.purpose: Create users (add members to the team)
Search team members by username and status
List users in a team group

audit_log_api.notes: Audit events (user actions and API operations) are routed into a designated audit team and queried like logs; no dedicated audit-log API is documented.

limitations.text: The service overview table lists team-scoped paths (/aaa/teams/v2/{team_id}/members); the per-method reference pages document /aaa/users/v2 routes. The per-method paths are recorded here.
Requests must go to the account's regional host; seven regional base URLs are documented.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update and Deactivate as checked (read from page markup); Group Push not checked on the OIN page although Coralogix's guide describes pushing groups.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SSO only; Coralogix documents SCIM with Entra through a non-gallery Enterprise Application and the generic endpoint.

onelogin.notes: Coralogix's guide uses OneLogin's generic 'SCIM Provisioner with SAML (SCIM v2 Core)' app; no Coralogix-specific OneLogin connector checked (OneLogin pages block bots).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud says SAML SSO must be configured to use SCIM and lists userName as required plus core and enterprise optional mappings.

fallbacks.other_sync: SAML group sync (group memberships updated from SAML assertion on every SSO login)

conflicts.text: The Users Management service overview lists team-scoped paths (/aaa/teams/v2/{team_id}/members, /members/status, /search) while the per-method pages document /aaa/users/v2 routes with team_id as an optional query parameter.

open_questions: SCIM docs do not publish a schema reference: filtering, pagination, PUT vs PATCH, discovery endpoints and enterprise/custom attributes are undocumented.
Docs do not say whether SCIM deactivation ends active sessions.
SCIM token (Team API key) expiry is not documented.
No Google Workspace catalogue app found; not checked in Google's admin help.
Whether audit events can be pulled through a dedicated API (vs querying the audit team's logs) is not documented.
API rate limits and user-event webhooks not found.
